Join the ecosystem trusted by leading asset managers Why choose RiskConcile? Our differentiators Technology built by experts RiskConcile is a FinTech company crafted by engineers with extensive operational backgrounds in financial markets. Our meticulously designed IT data models ensure a robust golden source of data, delivering consistent outputs across related regulatory documents such as EPT, EMT, KID, KIID, TPT, and SFDR. Adaptable and client-focused Our objective is always to automate data consumption through SFTP, automatically generated emails, and APIs, connecting directly with administrators to receive nav data or trade files. Being in control of our software allows us to make “changes on the fly” to accommodate specific client needs. We never impose our own file format on clients. Instead, we analyze existing data flows and infrastructure, adapting ourselves to how the client is organized. Our client-centric approach ensures that we provide the highest level of service and support. Exceptional analytical capabilities Our team possesses extremely strong mathematical and analytical skills, which enable us to handle the most complex data sets, models, and financial instruments with ease. This technical expertise ensures that we can provide precise and reliable solutions for our clients. Innovation and efficiency Innovation is at the heart of what we do at RiskConcile. We continually develop and integrate new solutions to stay ahead of industry trends and provide our clients with cutting-edge technology. Our focus on efficiency aims to enhance operational efficiency and reduce complexities for our clients. By streamlining processes and automating data consumption, we help our clients achieve their goals more effectively. High team stability RiskConcile thrives on inspiring leadership that transforms our workplace into a welcoming home for our team. Over the past three years, we have maintained very low turnover among our employees, ensuring continuity towards clients. We believe in the power of teamwork and treat our colleagues like family. Our open workspace is designed to facilitate easy cooperation among developers, allowing them to share valuable feedback from our clients and continually enhance our solutions. Transparency and Integrity We maintain transparency in all our operations and reporting. By adhering to high ethical standards and regulatory compliance, we ensure that our clients can trust us with their most critical data and processes. Integrity is a core value at RiskConcile. We adhere to high ethical standards and ensure regulatory compliance in all our operations, providing our clients with reliable and trustworthy services. Outstanding client retention We boast a near-zero churn rate, having lost no clients that represented more than 1% of our total revenue over the last three years, demonstrating our commitment to client satisfaction and long-term relationships. Centralized operations We take great pride in ensuring that all our production and coding are done in-house, right here in Leuven. By keeping everything local, we maintain the highest quality standards and foster close collaboration within our team. Rest assured, none of our work is offshored to other countries; everything happens in Leuven. Bespoke development Even if you can’t find what you are looking for, we are here to help.
